overloads.semanticRole: The WP Get text command retrieves text contents from a 4D Write Pro document within the specified targetObj .

constraints: If expressions is omitted, 4D expression references within targetObj are evaluated and returned in their evaluated form (equivalent to wk expressions as value, the default).
Only the wk expressions as space option keeps returned plain-text indexes consistent with the text range indexes used by WP/ST commands.
